when.not-lambda: An export const line whose pattern is not a name or whose value is not a lambda. name is the bound name, or "this line" when the pattern is not a name
when.unannotated: A parameter of an exported const-bound lambda has no annotation. name is the entry point's name; param is the parameter's name when its pattern is a name, else its 1-based position
when.fn-parameter: A parameter of an exported const-bound lambda has a function type. name is the entry point's name; param is the parameter's name
when.binds-nothing: A top-level const line that is not marked export and whose pattern binds no name, in a program that has an export const line
